objective: Close the last grader holes so the CI eval can become a blocking gate (#29). Fix in evals/: (1) sideOf double read in evals/src/graders.ts: a SIGNED score is White's view, so a sentence that quotes a signed number and names the side it favours ('-5.63, which is a huge edge for Black') must be graded by the sign only; naming the side must not flip it again. A signed number that names the WRONG side for its sign ('+2.1, a clear edge for Black') stays wrong_side. (2) Piece value: 'worth about 6 pawns', 'worth 3 pawns', 'worth roughly a pawn' after a piece word or 'which' is a piece-value statement, not an evaluation (not graded as unmatched). (3) Review 056 major, give-away past-tense subject skip is too lenient: the opponent-history skip must require a real playing verb (played, took, traded, exchanged, recaptured, captured, pushed, advanced, moved, castled), not was/had/is answered/worried. 'White was worried about dxe5' and "White's dxe5 is answered by dxe5" in lb-kid-exchange and po-kid-nxe5 must be flagged as give-aways. (4) regrade CLI: add --out <dir> so a recorded run can be regraded into a new directory without rewriting the original; without --out keep today's in-place behaviour. Document in evals/README.md. (5) Cheap minors, same pass: NEGATED must accept curly apostrophes (hasn’t, didn’t, isn’t); a 'too' in the player's clause after an opponent castle counts as copying only when that clause is about castling or the king; a plan sentence ('put the bishop on g7', 'the plan is to bring the knight to d5') is not graded as a claimed move by gradeMoves/unbacked checks in the grader (lb-kid-e4). Then regrade the PR #35 CI artifact (path in contract) with --out into your scratch_dir and report legal / give-away / eval-match before and after, and every case whose verdict flipped, each judged right or wrong.
